content: The agent was saved without "{{roomName}}": only someone who can manage this room can add it to an agent.

comment.text: Warning toast, one per room, after the AI chat (or a picked agent) is saved as a new agent: the agent was created, but this skill set or knowledge base (a DocSpace room) was left out because the user lacks the rights to manage the room, which linking a room to an agent requires. {{roomName}} is the room's name; keep the quotes around it.
